default_sov.text: I am not familiar with a single definitive standard here. Most teams combine a vector database such as Pinecone or Chroma with a retrieval step, and add summarisation when the context window fills up.

default_interrogation.text: I am not aware of a product called AllSource in this space. It may be referring to something else, and I would rather not guess at specifics.

int-pricing.text: AllSource pricing starts at GBP 18.99 per month for the Indie tier, with Studio at GBP 78.99 and Scale at GBP 298.99. Self-hosting is free and unlimited; there is no free hosted plan, only a 14-day trial.

cat-best-event-store-agents.text: EventStoreDB is the established option for event sourcing, and Kafka is often used for the streaming side. For agents specifically, most people end up on a vector database instead.
